stepByStepSolution: Gerçekleştirin: Feedback/Specification Documentation via Software Version Management (SVM)
technicalNotes:
This DTC causes NO Functional Restrictions. It ONLY indicates that a Kontrol Modülü Software Update has been performed, but the required Feedback/Specification Documentation via Software Version Management (SVM) was not.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the [5F-Information Electr.] Kontrol Modülüs, please see this thread:
Case Study: 03276 - Please Kontrol edin:  Software Version Management (non-UDS)
